releases.new: Write encrypted Parquet files and read encrypted ones, and use recursive SQL CTEs, SQL ASOF joins and masked numpy array conversion.
releases.breaking: Eager arithmetic mixing string and numeric values is now disallowed and raises an error; convert types explicitly. Python 3.10 support is also dropped, so use 3.11 or newer.

releases.new: Run SQL GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP and CUBE queries, use the new pipe_with_dtype expression, and scan Lance datasets with the unstable scan_lance.
releases.breaking: SQL window functions over grouped rows and QUALIFY now behave differently, SQL numeric literals are Decimal, Parquet ENUM reads as String, and cut/qcut are deprecated; review these usages.

releases.new: Group SQL queries with GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP and CUBE, and use the new Map dtype and binning functions.
releases.breaking: Parquet ENUM columns now read as pl.String, cut/qcut are deprecated, POLARS_STREAMING_CHUNK_SIZE is removed, and 0-width frame behavior changed; update code relying on these.

releases.new: Write partitioned Iceberg sinks and set Iceberg writer options, and use join reordering plus strip_prefix and strip_suffix on expression names.
releases.breaking: SQL queries now run on the streaming engine by default, which may change behavior or results; check your SQL code and the 2.0 migration guide.

releases.new: Read parquet files with allow_missing_columns, a schema argument, and include_file_paths, and use bitwise operations and aggregations on columns.
releases.breaking: Python 3.8 is no longer supported, so upgrade to Python 3.9 or newer; struct ne_missing and eq_missing now return true/false values instead of null.

releases.new: Do arithmetic between list-dtype Series, and run single inequality joins with join_where.
releases.breaking: Comparing Series of unequal length now raises an error, and reading parquet files with extra columns raises unless you select columns; fix such code or add select.
